北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京艳阳高照，体感 34℃，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and feels like 34℃. Stay hydrated and protected!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有点阴沉闷热，体感 31℃，记得清爽出行哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is muggy and 31℃. Keep cool and stay comfortable!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨绵绵，体感 32℃，出门记得带伞，注意防滑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels like 32℃. Bring an umbrella and watch your step!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云炎热，体感 34℃。及时补充水分，小心中暑。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and hot, feels like 34℃. Stay hydrated to avoid heatstroke.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云炎热，体感 34℃。别忘了防晒，多喝水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and hot, feels like 34℃. Don't forget sunscreen and drink plenty of water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阵雨来袭，体感 32℃，出门带伞，小心路滑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has showers, feels like 32℃. Take an umbrella and be careful on wet roads.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有点闷热，体感 32℃。注意防暑，保持凉爽哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is a bit stuffy and 32℃. Stay cool and beat the heat!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都酷热 34℃，多喝水，小心别中暑啦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is scorching at 34℃. Drink plenty of water and avoid heatstroke!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨微凉，体感 31℃，出门带伞，注意防潮。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain, feels like 31℃. Bring an umbrella and stay dry.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安有点闷热，体感 32℃。别忘了多补充水分哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is a bit stuffy and 32℃. Remember to drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨，体感 25℃，出门记得带伞，小心路滑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain, feels like 25℃. Bring an umbrella and watch your step.
重庆.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨今天有点阴沉，体感 23℃，出门记得带件外套哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast and 23℃. You might want a light jacket when you go out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 24℃，注意添衣，别着凉了哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels like 24℃. Dress appropriately and don't catch a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 22℃，出门记得加件衣服，注意保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels like 22℃. Add a layer when you go out to stay warm.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 30℃，记得防晒，多喝水哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 30℃. Remember sunscreen and drink plenty of water!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 26℃，出行注意交通安全，别着急。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and 26℃. Drive safely and take your time.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 24℃，风力 4级，注意防风别着凉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like 24℃ with a level 4 wind. Stay warm and mind the breeze!
